body:
cardigan weather.

that is a starter chip, word for word, and this is what it actually handed back:

never grow up (speak now) — a lullaby to a child that turns out to be a lullaby to herself, alone in a new apartment.
seven (folklore) — two little girls plotting pirate escapes, remembered decades on.
tim mcgraw (debut) — a goodbye that just wants to be remembered when the right song comes on.
new year’s day (reputation) — after twelve tracks of armor, she just wants whoever holds the trash bag.
we were happy (fearless) — cataloging the golden middle of a love, because the happiness is what hurts to recall.

five songs, five different eras, from two words.

tap Mood at the top of the page and try your own.

longlivets.com/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mood-chat

📷 the 63rd grammys, march 2021 — the night folklore won album of the year. kevin mazur/getty images for the recording academy.
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-16 23:00Z IG, launch:mood-chat day +4 (example output), hook = the chip label VERBATIM as the first line, exactly as the calendar and mood-starters.ts require (approved copy, never reworded). The result is REAL, not invented: the chip path is deterministic and model-free, and this exact vector was run against the live endpoint at www.longlivets.com/api/mood on 2026-08-11, returning Never Grow Up / seven / Tim McGraw / New Year’s Day / We Were Happy in that order, with the one-liners quoted from the response. Every returned song sits in a scored era — nothing from evermore, Midnights, TTPD or TLOAS, per the coverage-gap rule. MEDIA, disclosed: this reuses /social/library/mood-chat-screen.png, four days after the 08-12 announce, because the library has only two Mood assets and the ideal image (a screenshot of this actual result) cannot be captured in a queue-only PR. Recommend Tree/Growth capture a real result screenshot for the next Mood beat. DEPLOY DEPENDENCY: needs #1903 deployed. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. Rescheduled after the Taylor-photo set; upgraded to a carousel (folklore-era photo tile — the post is about the "cardigan weather" chip — with the Mood screenshot as slide 2) so its tile does not repeat mood-chat-screen.png days after the announce post. | Review fix (PR #2043): dropped the mood-chat-screen.png slide 2 — it would have repeated the 08-16 announce tile inside the last-10 posted-IG window, which the repeat rule exists to prevent (queued-vs-queued repeats are now checked at draft time too).
mediaCredit: Kevin Mazur/Getty Images for The Recording Academy
failureReason: Retired here by hand on 2026-08-15 rather than shipped, under the third-party image policy (docs/decisions.md 2026-08-15): its only media, taylor-folklore-grammys-2021.jpg, was a Getty preview comp and has been removed from apps/web/public/social/library/photos/. Instagram requires at least one image (queue-schema.mjs), this item has no fallback screenshot slide (PR #2043 review already dropped the mood-chat-screen.png slide 2 to avoid a repeated tile), and clearing the media field entirely is not a valid image-less option on Instagram — so there is no in-place fix that keeps this item postable. WHAT TO DO WITH IT: the writing and the sourced Mood-endpoint result are still valid; requeue with a non-Getty photo (hotlinked with credit, or a fresh corpus asset) and a new scheduledAt.
